source_question: FMC Attachment改成FMC获客和降低离网；Attachment是什么意思，放在这里合适吗？
meaning_cn: FMC 融合转化（或融合渗透），指将现有单业务用户转化为 FMC 用户的比例或过程。
explanation_cn: 在电信业务中，attachment 或 attach rate 通常表示某项附加服务在基础用户中的绑定或转化，例如把 FBB 用户转化为 FMC 用户。它不等同于降低离网，因此 FMC attachment and churn reduction 表示两个并列杠杆。如果一个 30% 指标同时包含用户转化和保有贡献，可写为 FMC Subscriber Conversion and Churn Reduction，避免把全部贡献都归入 attachment。

examples.en: FMC attachment measures how many FBB subscribers are converted into converged customers.
examples.cn: FMC 融合转化衡量有多少 FBB 用户被转化为融合用户。

examples.en: Higher FMC attachment can improve retention and customer value.
examples.cn: 更高的 FMC 融合渗透可以改善用户保有和客户价值。

examples.en: The 30% contribution includes both FMC subscriber conversion and churn reduction.
examples.cn: 这 30% 的贡献同时包括 FMC 用户转化和离网降低。

pronunciation.hint_cn: FMC 逐字母读；attachment 重音在第二音节。

source_question: 需加速HFC Copper用户迁转以维持市场领导地位
core: Accelerate HFC and copper subscriber migration to maintain market leadership.
meaning_cn: 加速 HFC 和铜线用户迁转，以维持市场领导地位。
explanation_cn: accelerate + 名词短语适合表达需要加快某项行动。HFC and copper subscriber migration 将两类传统接入用户并列处理；如果迁转目标需要写清楚，可用 Accelerate the migration of HFC and copper subscribers to FTTH。to maintain market leadership 说明迁转的战略目的。
source_sentence: 需加速HFC Copper用户迁转以维持市场领导地位

examples.en: Accelerate HFC and copper subscriber migration to maintain market leadership.
examples.cn: 加速 HFC 和铜线用户迁转，以维持市场领导地位。

examples.en: The operator is accelerating the migration of legacy subscribers to FTTH.
examples.cn: 该运营商正在加速传统网络用户向 FTTH 迁转。

examples.en: Faster migration can protect service quality and market leadership.
examples.cn: 更快的迁转可以保障业务体验和市场领导地位。

pronunciation.text: Accelerate HFC and copper subscriber migration to maintain market leadership.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 accelerate、HFC、copper subscriber migration、maintain 和 market leadership；HFC 逐字母读。

source_question: 20%–40% FBB Share Shows the Strongest FMC Pull on MBB Growth，给我具体一点的描述：>20%的FBB明显比<20%的更加能够促进MBB的增长。
core: Cities with FBB shares above 20% show significantly stronger MBB growth than those below 20%.
meaning_cn: FBB 份额高于 20% 的城市，其 MBB 增长明显强于 FBB 份额低于 20% 的城市。
explanation_cn: 用 Cities with... than those below... 可以直接比较两组城市，避免标题中的 FMC pull 过于抽象。show stronger growth 适合描述数据观察；如果尚未证明严格因果关系，show 比 drive 或 promote 更稳妥。those below 20% 中 those 代指 cities，避免重复。
source_sentence: 20%–40% FBB Share Shows the Strongest FMC Pull on MBB Growth.

examples.en: Cities with FBB shares above 20% show significantly stronger MBB growth than those below 20%.
examples.cn: FBB 份额高于 20% 的城市，其 MBB 增长明显强于低于 20% 的城市。

examples.en: Markets with higher FMC penetration show stronger mobile subscriber growth.
examples.cn: FMC 渗透率更高的市场呈现更强的移动用户增长。

examples.en: The data shows a clear growth gap between cities above and below the 20% FBB-share threshold.
examples.cn: 数据显示，FBB 份额高于和低于 20% 门槛的城市之间存在明显增长差距。

pronunciation.text: Cities with FBB shares above 20% show significantly stronger MBB growth than those below 20%.
pronunciation.hint_cn: FBB 和 MBB 逐字母读；重读 above 20%, significantly stronger 和 below 20%。

source_question: Move Priority Cities into the 20%–40% FBB Share Band to Unlock FMC-Led MBB Growth，标题改一下；unlock是不是有点不太好？
core: Move priority cities into the 20%–40% FBB share band to drive FMC-led MBB growth.
meaning_cn: 推动重点城市进入 20%–40% 的 FBB 份额区间，以带动 FMC 驱动的 MBB 增长。
explanation_cn: 在行动型 PPT 标题中，drive 比 unlock 更直接，强调该动作对增长的推动作用；unlock 更侧重释放尚未实现的潜力。FMC-led 作复合形容词修饰 MBB growth，需要连字符。move cities into a share band 表示把城市业务发展到目标份额区间。
source_sentence: Move Priority Cities into the 20%–40% FBB Share Band to Unlock FMC-Led MBB Growth.

examples.en: Move priority cities into the 20%–40% FBB share band to drive FMC-led MBB growth.
examples.cn: 推动重点城市进入 20%–40% 的 FBB 份额区间，以带动 FMC 驱动的 MBB 增长。

examples.en: Raise FBB penetration in priority cities to drive converged subscriber growth.
examples.cn: 提升重点城市的 FBB 渗透率，以推动融合用户增长。

examples.en: The next phase should focus on moving selected cities into the target share band.
examples.cn: 下一阶段应重点推动选定城市进入目标份额区间。

pronunciation.text: Move priority cities into the 20%–40% FBB share band to drive FMC-led MBB growth.
pronunciation.hint_cn: FBB、FMC、MBB 逐字母读；重读 priority cities、share band、drive 和 growth。
